summary: Swami Vivekananda Airport (RPR) serves Raipur, the capital of Chhattisgarh state in central India. Originally known as Mana Airport, it was renamed in honor of the revered Indian monk and philosopher Swami Vivekananda. It functions as an important regional gateway, supporting the state's industrial, mining, and agricultural sectors with domestic connectivity.
faqs:
Q: How far is Swami Vivekananda Airport from Raipur city center?
A: The airport is located approximately 15-20 km southeast of central Raipur, with typical travel times of 30-45 minutes depending on traffic conditions.
